services.name: Bottom Fishing
services.desc: Available (November Thru February); This is an easy, no-experience-necessary, “fun” Kauai Bottom Fishing Charters that are great for the whole family as an alternative to a offshore deep sea fishing charter trip. Bottom fishing on Kaua’i is done with the boat stopped, sometimes anchored, but usually drifting over favored locations known to support fish such as jacks, snapper, wrasse, goatfish, and more. Fish caught “Shallow water bottom fishing” are generally smaller than what you’d catch “Deep Sea Fishing on kaua’i,” usually weighing no more than 1-5 pounds, although you can get lucky and hook into much larger fish. services.name: Whale Watching
services.desc: Every year hundreds of humpback whales migrate to Kauai’s warm ocean waters. Over an 80-day time span, they travel 3000 miles - navigating on instinct alone - from the icy waters of Alaska to reach the soothing warmth of Kauai where they come to breed and give birth to new generations. Enjoy the intimate experience of being on board the 34-foot LAHELA and seeing these incredible mammals up close and personal. Acrobatic animals, the excitement comes when you see them breach and slap the water. After all, a Hawaiian humpback whale can be up to 50 feet in length and weight up to 79,000 pounds. blurb: Guests cruise along Kauai’s coastline aboard the 36-foot Kaimanu, the only US Coast Guard certified fishing boat on Kauai. They can fish for ahi tuna, ono, mahi mahi, skipjack tuna, or Pacific blue marlin. The boat accommodates up to 11 passengers for fishing, snorkeling, whale watching, and sightseeing trips.
